newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnian Moslem intelligence figure killed - radio.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian Moslem intelligence figure killed - radio.

text.p: A senior figure in Bosnian government intelligence operations was killed in Sarajevo on Saturday night, state radio reported on Sunday.
Nedzad Ugljen was killed between 8 p.m. and 8:30 p.m. local time in the new part of the city, Bosnian radio said.
The government broadcast gave no other details about how Ugljen died but did say authorities were asking citizens with information about the incident to come forward.
Government sources said Ugljen headed the Bosnian Ministry of Interior intelligence services during the country's 43-month war against Serb and Croat separatists.

More recently he had been serving as an assistant to the director of Bosnia's Agency for Investigation and Documentation (AID), a shadowy intelligence office which answers to President Alija Izetbegovic.
United States officials have been highly critical of AID, suggesting it may have ties to Iran.
